Skip tanks whose operation material is short (they stay queued, marked BLOCKED_MATERIAL); tanks on hold are never dispatched
Under DEFAULT_REPAIRABLE_RETURN_V1 an authorised rework goes to the station that performed the operation; an alternate station needs a logged approval (equipment down, or origin occupied > 30 min)
